featured_reviews.name: Bharatbhushan Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: I would give a 5 star rating to radhe stationery even though I have just visited the place once till date. I still remember I had my B-School Entrance exam scheduled on 29th Jan 2023 and I reached the center from Pune just 1.5 hours early and there I got to know that we were required to bring a colour print of Admit Card for exam. And then I rushed to the nearest Xerox/Stationery Shop to my exam center but all of them were closed because it was Sunday. I tried calling the owners of those stationery shops but none of them showed any interest in opening the shop early at 9 (just bcoz it was a weekend). But then one of the street vendor's told me suggested me to visit Radhe Stationery because they open their shop early especially to help the students on exam days. So I reached the Radhe Stationery Shop but it was closed so I tried to contact the owner and told her about my situation and she assured me that she'll reach the shop in 5 minutes and get give the printouts. I was actually shocked to see her there just to help me and give me my printouts. I am thankful to her because of the kindful and helpful gesture. Sometimes people think of monetary benefits involved in the work done by them but I was shocked to see the effort taken by the Owner of Radhe Shop as they just earned 10-15 rupees behind the work. I would surely suggest people should visit her shop and get their printing/xerox work done as well as purchase stationery.

featured_reviews.review_text:
On 21st September 2024 we had purchased this 6x6 Rubik's Cube from this damn Anupam stationery. They sweetly did not issue the bill and on trust we took the product. Next day some pieces poped out and when we had gone for replacement they refused to accept as we had no bill. What a scam ? Guys better buy online they never do this. Also offline stores pls don't cry "you don't get business nowadays".  This is what you do to your customers when they trust you Huh.
-–------------------------
The story continues and this time it's positive. Guys got a call from Mr.Sachin Shah floor manager on 25/02/25 (6months later is better late than never :)} Anupam Stationery and he took cognizance of the issue and has give a replacement product. All is well that ends well. I am upgrading the ratings from 1 to 3.5. I am always for offline buying it gives product with a buying experience which online can never give. Once again kudos to Sachin Shah from Anupam Stationery for not ignoring even small issues. Well Done Dear Sachin💐

featured_reviews.review_text: Anupam Stationery is a two-storied, mammoth-sized space filled with a plethora of options for all kinds of stationery and art needs. The staff is friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable, making the shopping experience smooth and enjoyable. Great service, great products, and an overall must-visit for stationery lovers!

featured_reviews.name: Gazal Nakra
featured_reviews.review_text: One stop shop for all the stationary items. Located in Borivali West just opposite station. Parking could be done in the nearby mall area otherwise parking is a challenge. They sell mostly the products from China. People who have idea will understand that prices of all the items are on a higher side. We bought many gift items in bulk still no discount was given, moreover they did not even provide bags for it. We had to purchase the bags from them which were of very low quality and highly priced. I would never go there for the second time. Better to visit some small shops where you will get good quality and good price. There are many shops nearby which can be explored.
